lessons.title: ICY ANIMATE WORKFLOW
lessons.description:
Load your image and video, and run the Klein Swap. Might take a couple tries to get the good first frame, nothing I can do about that (model skill issue)

If you do not want to use Klein swap, connect the load image directly to the Set_Referenceimage

When you're happy with your first frame, lock the seed and activate the preprocessing group and run the workflow

The higher the resolution, the higher the processing time. You will need to do some basic math to determine how many frames you do per sampler, this amount you can do per sampler will depend on your available amount of VRAM. The more you have the more frames you can do at once. For example, using a RTX PRO 6000 you can do as many frames as you want at once.

I recommend starting medium res (3) with 81 frames chunks (5seconds) per sampler and go up or down from there depending on your hardware and chosen resolution.

you will need access to sam3 and klein for all to work guide in blue node isnt fully updated

path: NEW - Minimax reference based Image generation
lessons.title: NEW - Minimax reference based Image generation
lessons.description:
How it works: We use the hybrid FL2VA/REF2VA model with references to create a consistent character (face and body), add clothing and environment references (cosplay/bedroom) and then we send everything to a Local LLM (Qwen 3.8 27b running in LLama cpp in my case) armed with a foolproof system prompt that will generate custom prompts based on the inputs we provide. We do get plasticky skin in some instances but it's nothing a quick upscale with Klein or Krea can't fix. Even better if you have a LoRA trained already. 

This specifically covers the initial generation tho not the full upscale pipeline.
Not using the 8steps lora should grant better image quality but will be slower

The most important part in this workflow is the prompting, in my case, the LLM I use for the prompting is running on my second computer on the same network which means I don't need to share VRAM between Comfy and LM studio. 

This will not be the case for most people so you should check unload_after in my LM studio node if you don't have a lot of VRAM to spare.

You need to install LM studio and download the LLM you want to use to use the node properly, it will not work without that. Your base URL will be 127.0.0.1:1234

I am releasing this before the showcase video is up but the vid will explain the details more in depth for easy understanding

This workflow contains 2 of my custom nodes: Icy multiref loader & Icy multimodal Prompt
Just drop the folders in your custom nodes folder, they should work right away

I highly recommend Sageattention for a 2x speed boost if you have supported hardware.
This might not work as well on Runpod due to the local LLM part but there are ways, just hit me up.

Main model: https://huggingface.co/smhfacct/Minimax-H3-fl2va-ref2va-hybrid-models/resolve/main/minimax_h3_hybrid_fl2va_ref2va_b25-49-int8.safetensors

lessons.title: IG Carousel pose generator
lessons.description:
This workflow will let you prompt for the pose you want and generate it in seconds without affecting the background of your original images (most of the time) 

Don't have a vid on this yet but it's quite simple to use, upload your image, put in your prompt(s) and generate. 

There is also the option to apply your Klein character lora if you have one.Using a Klein lora with this workflow will significantly improve your results/Likeness of your character

There are no limits to the amount of prompts you can add, just make sure every prompt is on a new line in the CR prompt List node and that there are no spaces between the lines. 

You can use the same simple prompt formula I use, simply describe the new pose, no need for multi sentence prompts

This is specifically aimed at carousel content where there shouldn't be drastic changes across images

The workflow uses the newer KV version of Flux Klein 9B but the original version should work just as good

lessons.title: Uncensored captioning for datasets
lessons.description:
What's up gang lot of people asked for this so here is an uncensored workflow to caption your images locally using the Huihui abliterated (uncensored) version of QWEN3VL. 

This is based on a node I created so add the ComfyUI-IcyQwen3 folder to your custom_nodes folder and install requirements with pip -r requirements.txt if you're missing some

The preselected fp8 version should be able to run on around 8gb of VRAM but you can select the non fp8 version and quantize it to 4bit if you need it to be smaller

Captioning can be slow on windows but is blazing fast on Linux (Including runpod) it's a architecture diff nothing I can do about it. 

Just set the path to your dataset folder and Queue up the workflow. Super easy!

My node can also be used to caption videos, just plug the video frames in the frames input and select the video setting. You can specify exactly what you want the captioning to be focused on were you can input text.

It can also be used to skip captioning in your workflows altogether by using a reference image. Many uses cases!

The free version will use the QWEN3 vl node available thru ComfyUi manager if you prefer using that.

lessons.title: Edit ANYTHING (Phr00t Qwen image edit)
lessons.description:
This powerful workflow uses a finetuned AIO version of Qwen Image Edit that was trained on content that could not be considered censored. This will let you do a lot of things that the original qwen image edit will not let you do.

This pipeline can be extremely useful to generate non-sfw datasets for your AI-influencer Lora trainings and other related material.

The workflow uses V18 as I had it made before the v19 release but you will be able to choose the version you want from the repo below!

AIO checkpoints: https://huggingface.co/Phr00t/Qwen-Image-Edit-Rapid-AIO/tree/main

This AIO contains the transformer, text encoder and Vae, so you don't need anything extra to run it.

The difference between the sub and free worfklows are those 2 things: 
Zturbo upscaling and extra batch processing if you need to do a specific edit on multiple images. 

I show the zturbo upscale setup at the end if you want to remake it for free, cheers!
